tail: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking falsehood. Towards those who curse me, let my soul be silent and let my soul be as dust in relation to everything. Open my heart to Thy Torah and let my soul pursue Thy commandments and as for all those that devise evil against me, speedily frustrate their counsel and upset their plan. Do this for the sake of Thy Name, do this for the sake of Thy right hand, do this for the sake of Thy holiness, do this for the sake of Thy Torah

text: so that those who love Thee may be delivered. Save with Thy right hand and respond to me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart find favour before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer.

tail: May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.
